0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_CHOICE1Q1_100_000
0.description: What would you like to know?

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_CHOICE1A2_102_000
2.description: What kind of place is this?

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_000_001
4.description: Oh, I like housing─that is to say, I <hex:021A020203>like<hex:021A020103> it. I roam this fair land─fairest!─touring all the adventurer settlements. You might say I'm a flatspotter. Or a house peeper.

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_100_001
5.description: Oh, one of us, are you? A fellow house peeper, very <hex:021A020203>good<hex:021A020103>! You must talk to the resident caretakers then. Connections are everything in this...proclivity.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_000_002
6.description: That cove right there is where Rycharde Mistbeard came home to his hideout. Mmm, lore! And brine! This is Mist, <hex:021A020203>the<hex:021A020103> residential area for adventurers─and a fine piece of Limsa it is too.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_000_003
7.description: Ah, the Goblet! Now who doesn't want to drink from <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103>, I ask. I was planning a trip to Ul'dah just to see this place, but plans kept getting pushed back. But finally, I'm here!

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_000_004
8.description: Now, this one might be my favorite residential area right now. The Lavender Beds! Such a relaxing area, don't you think? I've had a rather stressful few years, to be honest. The quiet life in Gridania, among the trees... <sigh>

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_000_005
9.description: Lest you wonder, Shirogane means platinum, and small wonder this place is named so. That pristine, glittering sand is a treat for eyes and feet alike. Truly a slice of Far Eastern paradise, this!

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_000_006
10.description: I had heard the people of Ishgard sought assistance to rebuild in the wake of the Dragonsong War, but never did I expect they would accomplish all this, and so quickly! Indeed, it is the epitome of masonry.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_004_000
11.description: I say, is this your chocobo by any chance? He <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103>? Wonderful, wonderful!

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_004_001
12.description: The fellow wandered here a while ago, looking rather glum for having been separated from his <hex:020815E905FF096D69737472657373FF076D617374657203>. I'm glad that you came by when you did─nothing warms the heart like a happy reunion!

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMRHOUSING_00140_MRHOUSING_004_002
13.description: Your chocobo companion has been returned to you, and may once again be summoned to your side.
